svg.title: Tattletale traces a fabricated quote to the agent that introduced it
svg.desc: Real output of demo/demo.py. The contract says renews automatically every 12 months. The researcher agent claims every 24 months (claim c_005). The editor carries it forward as c_010 and the summarizer as c_013, so the final output looks clean. Tattletale fails all three with NOT_IN_SOURCE and reports inherited from: researcher (c_005).
